name: ERTH 4991
title: Internship in Geoscience Research Paper
description: Preparation of written report and oral presentation to Department summarizing internship experience and evaluating the applicability of academic experience to job situations and the impact of the internship experience on academic and career plans.
requirement_description: ERTH 3010 and 3020 and 3030 and 3040, all of which may be taken concurrently. ERTH 4990 must be taken concurrently.
